name: Kazimierz Lewandowski
bio:
Kazimierz's hands have shaped more than a few winning cars. From a young age, he was fascinated by the construction of Formula 1 cars. This passion led him to pursue advanced studies in composite materials and engineering. After graduating, he honed his skills at a small racing team before joining a larger organization where he worked on various race cars.

Kazimierz is known for his methodical approach and unwavering attention to detail. He believes that the key to building a successful composite structure is to understand the material inside and out, from its molecular structure to its performance characteristics. He has a relentless work ethic, staying late to perfect his craft. He is also a firm believer in the power of experimentation, always looking for new ways to improve the strength and reliability of the composites he works with.

physical.hairStyle: short, neatly combed back with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: A man of average height with a strong build, suggesting a lifetime of hands-on work.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with technical diagrams and calculations.
Has a habit of meticulously cleaning his workstation before starting any new project.
Often hums quietly to himself while working, seemingly lost in thought.
